name: Profile Group Limited
note: Waikato-based window-and-door systems group; holds 75% of Architectural Glass Products Limited (NZ company 6919833). Its about page says the group began when the Plaw family established Vantage Aluminium in 1971 (profilegroup.nz/about-profile-group, fetched 2026-09-30). The Companies Register lists its 1,000 shares in four parcels, each held by Mitchell Stephen Plaw alone or with co-holders (register fetched 2026-09-30).
